description.description: Why you are reading, in plain words (5-10 words). The user reads it above the lines.

sources.description: What to read. Lines from every source are merged by timestamp.

namespace.description: The namespace the resource is in

resource.description: The resource as <kind>/<name>: pods/webapp-7f9c, deployments/webapp, statefulsets/db, daemonsets/agent, jobs/backfill, cronjobs/nightly, replicasets/webapp-7f9c

containers.description: Containers to read, by exact name. Omit for the default container, as kubectl logs does; the header names the others.

all_containers.description: Read every container of the pod, as kubectl logs --all-containers does. Not with containers.

previous.description: Read the instance before the last restart instead of the running one, as kubectl logs --previous does. It is finished: nothing arrives on it.

filters.description: Keep only lines from these nodes. Each is a list of values allowed; omit a key for any.

grep.description: A regular expression each line's message must match. Omit for every line.

since.description: Where the range starts: an RFC 3339 time at any precision, its first nanosecond, such as 2026-10-21 or 2026-10-21T05:00Z, or an ISO 8601 duration back from now such as PT15M. Omit for the oldest line Kstack holds.

until.description: Where the range ends, in the same forms; a time's last nanosecond, so 2026-10-21T05:00Z takes the whole minute. Omit for the newest line.

before.description: Context before the range: a number of lines (0 to 500), or an ISO 8601 duration of at most P7D such as PT5M. Its lines are marked [before] and pass the grep unfiltered.

after.description: Context after the range, in the same forms. Its lines are marked [after].

page_from.description: Which end of the window the page comes from: last (the default) the newest lines, first the oldest.

page_size.description: How many lines a page holds. Default 50.

max_message_bytes.description: Cut each message at this many bytes. Default 2048; 0 for the most Kstack keeps of a message, 16 KiB.

max_page_bytes.description: The page's messages together, in bytes. Default 16384.

cursor.description: A prev, next or follow token a read printed, copied whole and exactly. It names the sources, filters, grep and window, so send it with page_size, max_message_bytes, max_page_bytes and description alone.
